steps.title: Transfer IonCode Barcode Adapter
steps.instruction: Dispense 1 µL of IonCode Barcode Adapter from the source plate (from Parts 1 & 2) into the matching well of the Ion Code 96‑well plate, performing a one‑to‑one transfer for each well.

steps.title: Gather required labware and equipment
steps.instruction: Place the following items on the OT‑2 deck: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, P20 multi‑channel pipette, Opentrons 96‑filter tip rack (20 µL), ThermoFisher Scientific 96‑well plate 200 µL (catalog AB‑0800 or 4483352), BioRad hard‑shell 96‑well PCR plate (skirted), and any other consumables listed in the protocol.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the experimental parameters (e.g., number of samples, labware definitions) into the OT‑2 protocol editor.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Export the completed protocol file from the editor to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later), upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the labware on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tip rack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the positions of the tip rack, plates, and the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the barcoding step.
